S14.description: Supplementary Table 14: significant SMR results, GTEx uterus cis-eQTL vs the European endometriosis GWAS meta-analysis; full SMR columns (A1/A2, Frequency, GWAS and eQTL beta/SE/p, SMR beta/SE/p, HEIDI); one top SNP per probe.

Rahmioglu2023-1.notes: SMR top cis-eQTL rs72838653 (GTEx uterus) from Supplementary Table 14, the only row. A1 is the effect allele for both eQTL beta and GWAS beta; Frequency is the A1 frequency. GWAS beta / eQTL beta reproduces the table's SMR beta (-0.0553, OR 0.946). The row is marked Pass HEIDI = No (HEIDI p = 0.006).

Rahmioglu2023-2.reason: Supplementary Table 15 (SMR, endometrial eQTL) lists Gene, SNP, Chr, Position (hg19) and GWAS, eQTL, SMR and HEIDI p-values only, plus annotations; no alleles, allele frequency or eQTL/GWAS effect sizes (no b_SMR either). The SNP is not in the eQTL look-up tables (Supplementary Tables 31-32). Row Gene = LINC00339: top SNP rs2473290. The exposure is the Fung 2018 endometrial microarray eQTL dataset, whose per-variant effects are not in this supplement.
